name: Safeswim
description: Ingests beach water quality, lifeguard patrol status and active safety hazard alerts from the Safeswim API and posts them to the map as icon-coded beach locations.

permissions.description: Submits Safeswim beach location points to CloudTAK

schedule.description: Polls the Safeswim API for updated beach water quality, lifeguard patrol status and safety alerts on a schedule matching Safeswim's roughly 15 minute update frequency.
